verdict.rationale: CRA's own pages show a delegated-access mechanism: representatives must use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account, business users can "authorize access to online information," and representatives can file returns or make payments for clients. The pack contains no published detail on the scope of what a third party may or may not do. missing for 10: named authorization forms, defined representative roles or access levels, an explicit list of permitted versus prohibited representative actions, and which signatures or declarations must remain personal to the taxpayer.
